name: Netflow Network Analysis v2
description: Network communication analysis - who talks to whom, protocols, ports, and geographic enrichment with visual hierarchy.

0.content:
# Netflow Network Analysis v2
**Who is talking to whom?** Source/destination pairs, protocols, ports, and geographic insights with enrichment context.

1.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize total_bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0)))
| fieldsAdd total_gb = round(total_bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 2)
1.title: Total Data Transferred

2.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize unique_svcs = countDistinct(coalesce(`netflow.destination.port`, ""))
2.title: Unique Services

3.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize sources = countDistinct(coalesce(`netflow.source.ip`, ""))
3.title: Active Source IPs

4.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize destinations = countDistinct(coalesce(`netflow.destination.ip`, ""))
4.title: Active Destination IPs

5.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| makeTimeseries bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")}, interval: 5m
5.title: Traffic by Protocol (Time Series)

6.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| makeTimeseries bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown")}, interval: 5m
6.title: Traffic by Direction (Time Series)

7.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), by: {protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown")}
| sort bytes desc
7.title: Protocol Distribution

8.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flow_count = count(), by: {port = coalesce(`netflow.destination.port`, "unknown")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| sort bytes desc
| limit 10
8.title: Top 10 Ports

9.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flow_count = count(), by: {country = coalesce(`netflow.destination.country`, "unknown")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| sort bytes desc
| limit 10
9.title: Top Destinations by Country

10.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.openpipeline.source == "extension:custom:netflow-observability" and coalesce(content, "") != "collector_diagnostics"
| fieldsAdd src_name = if(isNotNull(`netflow.source.hostname`), then: `netflow.source.hostname`, else: `netflow.source.ip`)
| fieldsAdd dst_name = if(isNotNull(`netflow.destination.hostname`), then: `netflow.destination.hostname`, else: `netflow.destination.ip`)
| summarize bytes = sum(toLong(coalesce(`netflow.flow.io.bytes`, 0))), flows = count(), by: {source = src_name, destination = dst_name, direction = coalesce(`netflow.flow.direction`, "unknown"), protocol = coalesce(`netflow.network.transport`, "unknown"), dst_port = coalesce(`netflow.destination.port`, ""), provider = coalesce(`netflow.destination.provider`, "private"), asn = coalesce(`netflow.destination.asn`, ""), country = coalesce(`netflow.destination.country`, "")}
| fieldsAdd gb = round(bytes / 1073741824.0, decimals: 3)
| sort bytes desc
| limit 50
10.title: Top 50 Conversations (Source → Destination with Enrichment)
